lines.t: Verse 1
The world is loud, it pulls me in,
So many voices underneath my skin
But You don’t leave after just a day,
You stay the same, You don’t drift away
I don’t need answers, I don’t need control,
Just the safety of letting go
And in the quiet, You gently say,
“Stay with Me, don’t run away”
Pre-Chorus
So I slow my breathing, I close my eyes
Letting the heaviness fall behind
And I remember who You are to me
A steady light in uncertainty
Chorus
I'll stay with You, I'll stay with You
I'll feel Your peace, I'll feel Your quiet
I'll stay with You, I'll stay with You
This world I'll release, I won't stay by it
I'll stay with You, my God, I'll feel Your love, soft and slow
And in knowing You, peace I'll come to know
Verse 2
When the night feels long and I feel small
You’re the One who hears my silent call
No need for words, You understand
You hold my heart in gentle hands
Even when I drift and lose my way
You don’t let go, You don’t walk away
And slowly I return again
To where Your presence always has been
Pre-Chorus
So I lay it down, every fear I hold
Every shadow that feels too cold
And I remember who You are to me
A calm within the stormy sea
Chorus
I'll stay with You, I'll stay with You
I'll feel Your peace, I'll feel Your quiet
I'll stay with You, I'll stay with You
This world I'll release, I won't stay by it
I'll stay with You, my God, I'll feel Your love, soft and slow
And in knowing You, peace I'll come to know
If everything fades, You remain
Through every loss and every gain
You are the stillness in my soul
The place where I am finally whole
I don’t need more than You alone
You are my heart’s true resting home
Final Chorus (gentler, fading feel)
I'll stay with You, I'll stay with You
I'll feel Your peace, I'll feel Your quiet
I'll stay with You, I'll stay with You
This world I'll release, I won't stay by it
I'll stay with You, my God, I'll feel Your love, soft and slow
And in knowing You, peace I'll come to know
